name: Human Appeal USA
mission:
Human Appeal USA is a non-profit organization working across the globe to strengthen humanity’s fight against poverty, social injustice and natural disaster. Through the provision of immediate relief and the establishment of self-sustaining development programs, we aim to invest in real, effective solutions. 

Human Appeal USA is here for every human. Our work is focused at home as well as abroad, with our ongoing mission of poverty alleviation through dignified means.

rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1991, Human Appeal Inc is a global humanitarian organization dedicated to fighting poverty and social injustice through direct aid and emergency relief. The organization has demonstrated significant growth, managing <cite id="2">$10,889,699 in total revenue in FY2023</cite> and expanding its reach to support <cite id="4">over 6 million beneficiaries</cite>. Their operations focus on high-urgency sectors including food security, water and sanitation, and child welfare. In Gaza alone, the charity reported providing <cite id="4">4.5 million hot meals</cite> and <cite id="4">59 million liters of clean water</cite> in 2024. While the organization maintains <cite id="1">strong financial health with 10.7 months of working capital</cite>, it operates with a unique financial structure where the <cite id="1">program expense ratio is 50.3%</cite>. This indicates that roughly half of its total spending is directed toward administrative and fundraising efforts to sustain its global infrastructure. Despite this, the charity achieves a <cite id="1">high fundraising efficiency</cite>, spending only <cite id="1">$0.25 to raise every $1 in donations</cite>. Human Appeal is <cite id="3">fully Zakat-eligible</cite>, serving multiple categories of asnaf including the poor and needy across regions like Yemen, Syria, and Palestine.
